lessons_used: Helpful changes: Flow reordering, targeted guidance hints (photo lighting/quality, path helper, account restore/security), single-click and card carousel layouts, hotkey shortcut copy, and interactive waiting status updates reliably yield significant wins.

Harmful changes: Complex setup or placement flow overhauls, intrusive split-view or spotlight layouts, interactive practice flows, pick friend redesigns, and cheat sheet screens lead to performance drops or early terminations.
No effect seen: Dedicated tutorial or environment prep screens, static waiting hints and carousels, background completion notifications, and incentive badges consistently show no clear effect.
Predictions too high: Predictions of +8.0% or higher consistently overestimate actual impact, frequently resulting in no clear effect or severe negative outcomes.
Predictions too low: Shortcut hotkey copy, account security and identity hints, and interactive waiting status updates frequently outperform negative or low initial predictions.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Prior to Photo Upload Reorder
candidates.change: Reorder the adoption steps so users finalize their adoption certificate and companion commitment before uploading custom photos.
candidates.why: Adoption is the biggest drop-off point in the funnel (66.7% conversion). Securing pet name and certificate commitment early builds user investment before photo processing.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Retention Warning Hint
candidates.change: Display an explicit safety hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that authenticating restores their existing pet profile.
candidates.why: The top support theme last week was 'Pets missing or reset after signing in again' with 8 email complaints.

sign_in.hint: Signing into your existing account automatically restores your saved pet and customized traits.

guard.reason: Reassuring sign-in hint is within fair design and onboarding allowed modifications.

candidates.score_note: Targeted account restore security hint supported by top support ticket volume.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Summary Card Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate layout into a compact summary card featuring a clear mascot badge and direct confirmation button.
candidates.why: Adoption step has low conversion (66.7%) and long tail duration (1017s mean). Streamlining screen elements reduces drop-off.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.replace.certificate[0]': a mascot cannot do the certificate job (use ['animation', 'badge', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Pet Trait Assembly Progress Update
candidates.change: Add dynamic pet trait assembly updates and progress indicator to the waiting screen during pet rendering.
candidates.why: The waiting screen (home step) has a long mean completion time of 2336s. Interactive waiting updates have proven effective at keeping users engaged.

waiting.hint: Assembling companion traits and initializing desktop animation engine...

guard.reason: Adding trait assembly progress updates during a real wait is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Interactive waiting status updates reliably yield strong positive lifts.

candidates.title: Desktop Quick Control Discovery Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a new dedicated screen right before the final welcome screen explaining desktop pet controls and tray shortcuts.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails specifically asking how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after finishing onboarding.

new_control_guide.headline: Desktop Pet Quick Controls
new_control_guide.body: Use quick tray icons or desktop shortcuts to talk, hide, or summon your companion at any time.

guard.reason: Adding a new onboarding screen prior to home intro is permitted under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Dedicated tutorial/prep screens consistently show no effect or negative performance.

candidates.title: Path Selection Choice Guidance Flow
candidates.change: Implement a card-based path selection flow that highlights clear path choices with structured choice cards.
candidates.why: Choose path has a median completion time of 8s but a mean of 514s, indicating significant hesitation for undecided users.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Companion Experience
choose_path.hint: Pick a ready companion or upload photos to craft a unique custom pet.

guard.reason: Path selection layout redesign clearly offers both choosing a ready companion and making a custom pet.

candidates.score_note: Flow overhauls tend to underperform compared to simple targeted hints.

candidates.title: Photo Focus and Clarity Guidance Callout
candidates.change: Add a clear guidance hint on the photo upload screen recommending well-lit photos with a single focused subject.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails reporting custom pet generation failures or incorrect visual outputs.

upload_photos.hint: Upload a clear, well-lit photo with a single centered subject for optimal pet generation.

guard.reason: Photo clarity guidance hint is an acceptable addition to the photo upload step.

candidates.score_note: Photo quality hint targets the largest drop-off step with proven guidance pattern.

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Companion Quick Launch Copy
candidates.change: Update the home intro screen headline and body text to clarify pet screen presence and tray toggle controls.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails where users reported their pet did not show on the desktop after completing setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Active on Desktop!
home_intro.body: Your pet is now roaming your desktop. Use the system tray icon anytime to toggle visibility or access settings.

guard.reason: Updating text on the home intro overlay is allowed as part of onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Shortcut copy clarifications on finish step consistently show modest positive gain.

candidates.title: Centered Quick Sign-In Option Layout
candidates.change: Switch sign-in screen layout to a centered card focus emphasizing quick sign-in options.
candidates.why: Support logged 2 tickets regarding sign-in stalling or failing to load properly.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Companion Progress

guard.reason: Updating sign-in layout to centered style preserves its function and rules.

candidates.score_note: Centered card layouts on sign-in screen have high historical success rate.

candidates.title: Story Screen Card Intro Layout
candidates.change: Update the story intro screen layout to card format with step counter enabled for visual pacing.
candidates.why: Improves initial onboarding flow clarity and sets clear progression expectations from the first screen.

guard.reason: Updating the story intro screen layout preserves its core job of introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: Choose path layout changes historically yield near-zero or slightly negative effect.
